lines.label: B1
lines.reason: A real 90.9 deg fold between the base outer skin (patch 1) and the outer skin of the +e2 side leg (patch 3). In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the outer-arc apex, 0.27/0.24/0.10 mm from the apex estimate (nearest surface point within 0.04 mm). It is parallel to the fold. The apex points end at t=-0.3 and t=121.8 against a line span of 0 to 121.6, so it covers the whole fold from the corner relief notch to the open end.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: A real 90.2 deg fold between the base (patch 1) and the outer skin of the end wall (patch 7). Section offsets from the outer apex are 0.20/0.33/0.43 mm. It is parallel to the fold. The fold arc runs only between the two corner relief notches (about 37-38 mm), and the apex points span t=-0.9 to 36.7 against a line span of 0 to 35.9, so coverage is about 95% or more. The end wall's wider lower part, which covers the leg ends, butts against the legs at square, unradiused corners in horizontal slices, so those corners are not bends.
